t: Forge Steel contact tip pocket thermometer is a high precision electronic device designed for accurately measuring surface temperatures. The compact design makes it ideal for tradespeople needing quick temperature checks in commercial kitchens, HVAC systems, or industrial settings. Equipped with a durable stainless probe, this digital thermometer provides readings in both Celsius and Fahrenheit, covering a wide range from -40°C to 200°C. Includes maximum and minimum memory functions along with a data hold feature for convenient recording of measurements, ensuring precise results for various professional applications.
